headline_item.title_zh: 医疗智能初创Aevius获2200万美元种子轮融资
headline_item.title_en: Boston-based Aevius, whose foundation models analyze patient health using medical records, imaging, and other data, raised a $22M seed led by Insight Partners (Katherine Davis/Axios)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: Aevius完成2200万美元种子轮融资，Insight Partners领投，旨在利用医疗记录和影像数据驱动临床决策
headline_item.event_summary_en: Clinical intelligence startup Aevius has raised $22 million in seed funding led by Insight Partners. The founding team, leveraging their successful track record in selling clinical AI assets to Big Pharma, will focus on building foundation models that analyze EHRs, medical imaging, and multi-modal health data.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Aevius（临床智能初创公司），Insight Partners（领投方）在美国波士顿：完成2200万美元种子轮融资
【起因与机理】构建多模态医疗临床智能基准模型
【关键数据与实测】Aevius完成2200万美元种子融资以扩张临床智能基准模型研发。
【各方立场与态度】业务核心在于整合医疗记录与影像数据以优化诊疗效率。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Aevius (clinical intelligence startup), Insight Partners (lead investor) (Boston, USA): Raised $22M in seed funding
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Develop foundation models for multi-modal clinical intelligence
[Key Metrics] Aevius raised $22M seed funding for foundation model R&D.
[Key Position & Outlook] Focus on integrating longitudinal health records with imaging data.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 医疗AI领域正从单一任务算法转向多模态基准模型，通过深挖电子健康记录与影像的关联实现“数字临床专家”化。该领域商业护城河不仅在于模型参数，更在于是否具备与大型制药或医疗集团深度绑定的数据回流闭环。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: The medical AI landscape is shifting from single-task algorithms to multi-modal foundation models that function as 'digital clinical experts'. Success in this space depends less on sheer model scale and more on the ability to integrate into the proprietary data loops of Big Pharma and healthcare systems.

headlines.title_zh: 算力资产化平台Compute Desk获4500万美元融资
headlines.title_en: Compute Desk, which is building capital markets infrastructure to price, trade, hedge, and clear compute, raised a $45M seed round led by Lightspeed (Lucinda Shen/Axios)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 初创公司Compute Desk完成4500万美元种子轮融资，旨在构建算力定价、交易与对冲的资本市场基础设施
headlines.event_summary_en: Compute Desk raised $45 million in a seed round led by Lightspeed Venture Partners. Led by CEO Andrawes Bahou, the startup aims to build capital markets infrastructure to turn compute into a tradable, hedgeable asset, addressing the growing financialization of AI hardware resources.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Compute Desk（首席执行官：Andrawes Bahou）；光速创投在AI基础设施投融资市场：完成4500万美元种子轮融资，开发算力交易与风险管理平台
【起因与机理】算力市场化需求爆发，算力资产定价体系缺失
【关键数据与实测】Compute Desk完成4500万美元种子轮融资，由Lightspeed领投。
【各方立场与态度】行业处于AI算力定价基础设施构建的早期爆发期。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Compute Desk (CEO: Andrawes Bahou); Lightspeed Venture Partners (AI infrastructure funding market): Secured $45M seed funding to develop a compute trading and risk management platform
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Growing demand for standardized pricing and hedging in the trillion-dollar compute market
[Key Metrics] Compute Desk secured $45M seed funding led by Lightspeed.
[Key Position & Outlook] The sector is in an early-stage phase of building compute pricing infrastructure.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 算力从传统的IT成本中心向金融级资产转型，标志着计算资源正式进入大宗商品化阶段。通过引入期权与衍生品逻辑，该平台有望重构云厂商与大模型的成本结构，但核心瓶颈在于如何建立被行业广泛认可的算力资产准入与质量分级标准。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The transition of compute from a standard IT cost to a financial-grade asset signals the commodity era of AI hardware. By introducing derivatives-style hedging, this platform aims to reshape the cost structure for cloud providers and LLM developers, though success hinges on establishing widely accepted standardization for compute quality and throughput.

celebrity.author: Yann LeCun
celebrity.author_role_zh: Meta 首席AI科学家 / 深度学习三巨头 / 图灵奖得主
celebrity.quote_zh:
@RajeswarSai LLM 后期培训非常昂贵，正是因为 RL 的样本效率太低了。

在现实世界中，也就是我的蛋糕幻灯片的主题，强化学习只能发挥次要作用，正是因为它的样本效率低下。
celebrity.quote_en:
@RajeswarSai LLM post-training is so insanely expensive precisely because RL is so damn sample inefficient.

In the real world, which was the subject of my cake slide, RL can only play a minor role precisely because of its sample inefficiency.
